steps.en: Vehicle type and category are picked from lists
steps.id: Jenis dan kategori kendaraan dipilih dari list

steps.en: The car park is picked from a list of active car parks
steps.id: Car park dipilih dari list car park yang aktif

steps.en: Offence rule codes are shown in a list that fits the vehicle
steps.id: Rule code offence tampil di list yang sesuai kendaraan

steps.en: The fine amount is picked from a list that fits the rule and vehicle
steps.id: Jumlah denda dipilih dari list yang sesuai aturan dan kendaraan

steps.en: Remarks can be picked from a ready-made list
steps.id: Remark bisa dipilih dari list yang sudah disiapkan
